name: MiniCPM5-2B
notes: Read from config.json and the model card at revision 12a3808a: dense LlamaForCausalLM, 2,516,756,480 parameters (1,981,982,720 without embeddings), 42 layers, hidden 2048, 16 query heads and 2 KV heads of dim 128, vocab 130560, untied embeddings, rope_theta 5e6 with no rope scaling, max_position_embeddings 131072. Hybrid reasoning through the chat template: enable_thinking true prefills <think>, false prefills an empty think block, and leaving it unset lets the model decide (it thinks on most prompts). Tool calls are XML (<function name=...><param name=...>), parsed by SGLang's minicpm5 tool parser. The card recommends temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, min_p 0 and SGLang for tool calling; a DSpark drafter (openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-DSpark, 5 layers, 324M parameters, block size 7) is published for SGLang speculative decoding.
